inputs.prompt: Look up Project Minimi's Mac app. What are Cotton and Melody each for? Cite Minimi.

inputs.user_text: Look up Project Minimi's Mac app. What are Cotton and Melody each for? Cite Minimi.

tool_calls.name: web_search
tool_calls.arguments: {"queries": ["Project Minimi Mac app Cotton Melody", "Minimi app Cotton feature", "Minimi app Melody feature"], "intent": "answer"}

queries.query: Project Minimi Mac app Cotton Melody

outputs.content:
In Minimi 2.0 (launched September 24, 2026), the two AI cats split the work: **Cotton remembers, and Melody chases commitments.**

- **Cotton** — the memory side. It's the original cat (Minimi 1.0 was billed as "Your Ambient Memory layer for Claude"), and in 2.0 it's the one "who remembers" — personal context captured on your Mac [S5](https://chatgate.ai/en/post/minimi-2-0#1). Minimi's own site frames this as memory that "lives on your Mac, where it's safest," claiming 54% vs. 36% prior state of the art on the BEAM long-term memory benchmark [S12](https://www.projectminimi.com/memory).
- **Melody** — the follow-through side, introduced in 2.0 as "the Closer": it tracks down open loops such as promises made in chat channels and overlooked follow-ups, and per the launch framing "never lets you miss your commitments" [S27](https://coding4food.com/en/post/minimi-2-0-can-cute-ai-cats-solve-context-switching-nightmare) [S5](https://chatgate.ai/en/post/minimi-2-0#1).

One caveat on sourcing: the clearest descriptions of the Cotton/Melody split come from launch coverage and the Product Hunt listing as reported by third parties, not from a dedicated feature page on projectminimi.com — the official site page I found covers the memory capability rather than naming both cats [S12](https://www.projectminimi.com/memory).

**Sources**
- [S5](https://chatgate.ai/en/post/minimi-2-0#1) — minimi 2.0: AI cat that closes your open loops (2026-09-23)
- [S12](https://www.projectminimi.com/memory) — minimi: AI cat that knows you really well (projectminimi.com)
- [S27](https://coding4food.com/en/post/minimi-2-0-can-cute-ai-cats-solve-context-switching-nightmare) — Minimi 2.0 coverage (2026-09-23)
